changeSet.author: Opanasenko-Mykhailo
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE users ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, username VARCHAR(255), password VARCHAR(255), is_active BOOLEAN, first_name VARCHAR(255), last_name VARCHAR(255) )

changeSet.author: Opanasenko-Mykhailo
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE trainees ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, user_id BIGINT, date_of_birth DATE, address VARCHAR(255), CONSTRAINT fk_trainees_users FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) )

changeSet.author: Opanasenko-Mykhailo
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE training_types ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, training_type_name VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL )

changeSet.author: Opanasenko-Mykhailo
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE trainers ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, user_id BIGINT, specialization_id BIGINT, CONSTRAINT fk_trainer_users FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id), CONSTRAINT fk_trainer_training_type FOREIGN KEY (specialization_id) REFERENCES training_types (id) )

changeSet.author: Opanasenko-Mykhailo
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE trainings ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, trainee_id BIGINT, trainer_id BIGINT, type_id BIGINT, training_date DATE, training_duration INT, training_name VARCHAR(255), CONSTRAINT fk_training_trainee FOREIGN KEY (trainee_id) REFERENCES trainees (id), CONSTRAINT fk_training_trainer FOREIGN KEY (trainer_id) REFERENCES trainers (id), CONSTRAINT fk_training_type FOREIGN KEY (type_id) REFERENCES training_types (id) )

changeSet.author: Opanasenko-Mykhailo
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE trainee_trainer ( trainee_id BIGINT NOT NULL, trainer_id BIGINT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (trainee_id, trainer_id), CONSTRAINT fk_tt_trainee FOREIGN KEY (trainee_id) REFERENCES trainees (id), CONSTRAINT fk_tt_trainer FOREIGN KEY (trainer_id) REFERENCES trainers (id) )
